coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 14 of 17 ground-truth variable items (82%, rounded): consistent data splits; sequence length, forecast horizon, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, and RevIN use; batch size and synthetic-generation parameters; normalization and cycle-index generation; MSE, MAE, and loss-curve visualization outputs.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW instead of the specified fixed Adam configuration, proposes 50–100 synthetic-data epochs and 10–20 public-data epochs instead of 30, and does not specify the required single RTX 4090 with 24GB memory. Although loss curves are included, learned cyclic-pattern plots are not explicitly planned.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the conclusion describing a trained CycleNet that accurately forecasts future time-series values, accompanied by visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
